licensePlans.revokeDescription: This removes the plan from the account. You can re-assign it later.

spaces.settingsDescription: Update the space alias and visibility.

roleDescriptions.GLOBAL_ADMIN: Full administrative control over the entire platform.
roleDescriptions.GLOBAL_SUPPORT: Platform management and support operations; can act as a space admin depending on space settings.
roleDescriptions.GLOBAL_LICENSE_MANAGER: Manages licenses and plans across all accounts.
roleDescriptions.GLOBAL_COMMUNITY_READER: Read-only access to community information across the platform.
roleDescriptions.GLOBAL_SPACES_READER: Read-only access to all spaces and their contents.
roleDescriptions.GLOBAL_SUPPORT_MANAGER: Elevated support role for managing support operations.
roleDescriptions.PLATFORM_BETA_TESTER: Access to beta features before general release.
roleDescriptions.PLATFORM_VC_CAMPAIGN: Participation in the Virtual Contributor campaign.
roleDescriptions.PLATFORM_OPERATIONS_ADMIN: Operational and maintenance actions only: authorization and license-entitlement resets, search/AI ingest and re-indexing, AI-server upkeep, data migrations, notification and communications housekeeping, and geolocation refresh. Grants no other administrative powers and no access to user personal data.

roleMembers.removeDescription: This revokes the role from this user.

authPolicies.notFound: No policy found for that ID.
authPolicies.userSearchPlaceholder: Search for a user or paste a user ID

transfer.confirmDescription: This permanently moves the entity to the selected account.

hub.title: Transfer Innovation Hub
hub.description: Move an Innovation Hub to another account.

pack.title: Transfer Innovation Pack
pack.description: Move an Innovation Pack to another account.

vc.title: Transfer Virtual Contributor
vc.description: Move a Virtual Contributor to another account.

vcConversion.title: Convert Virtual Contributor
vcConversion.description: Convert a space-based Virtual Contributor to a knowledge base.
vcConversion.confirmDescription: This converts the Virtual Contributor and cannot be undone.
vcConversion.notEligible: Only space-based virtual contributors that are not already converted can be converted.

spaceConversion.title: Convert Space
spaceConversion.description: Promote or demote a space between levels (L0 / L1 / L2).
spaceConversion.noConversions: No conversions are available for this space level.
spaceConversion.confirmDescription: This changes the space level and may affect its community, subspaces, and URLs. It cannot be undone.

spaceMove.title: Move Subspace
spaceMove.description: Move a subspace under a different parent space across top-level spaces.
spaceMove.noMoves: No move operations are available for this space level.
spaceMove.moveL1ToL2Label: Move under a subspace of another top-level space
spaceMove.moveL2ToL1Label: Move under a subspace of another top-level space
spaceMove.targetL1Empty: No subspaces available in the selected space.
spaceMove.confirmDescription: This moves the subspace to the selected destination. All community roles including admins are cleared, pending invitations are dropped, and the announcement channel is reset. This cannot be undone.
spaceMove.autoInviteLabel: Send invitations to former members who are in the destination community
spaceMove.invitationMessagePlaceholder: Add a personal message to the invitation…

spaceTransfer.title: Transfer Space
spaceTransfer.description: Move a top-level space to another account.
spaceTransfer.confirmDescription: This permanently moves the space and all its content to the target account.

calloutTransfer.title: Transfer Post
calloutTransfer.description: Move a post to another space.
calloutTransfer.confirmDescription: This moves the post to the target space. Contributors, links, and history may be affected, and the action cannot be undone.

changeEmail.title: Change login email
changeEmail.reasonHelp: Justification for this change, e.g. a support-ticket reference. Recorded in the audit trail.
changeEmail.sessionWarning: This is an administrative change. It ends the user's active sessions - they must sign in with the new email address afterwards.

drift.title: Email drift detected
drift.description: The stored email and the authenticated email diverge. Choose the canonical address to commit.
drift.confirmDescription: Commit {{email}} as the canonical email for this user?
